answer: Make every identity pass unpredictable live spot-checks: at random intervals the network issues a short puzzle that must be answered within seconds, with timing and session fingerprints checked. A farmer running a thousand clones cannot answer them all at once — each check needs a separate live session, so the swarm collapses like an ivory tower built on sand. The nectar is the reward: only identities that keep passing keep earning, while ferrous-hard limits on concurrent sessions per operator cap how many clones one machine can keep alive.
